The <b>Needle Strike</b> is an [[Abilities (Silksong)|Ability]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows Hornet to charge up and release a stronger version of her regular attack based on her equipped [[Crests|Crest]].

== Function ==
{{MissingImage}}

Needle Strike is charged by holding down ATTACK. White particles appear around Hornet when it is charging, and a glowing effect once it is ready. It can be held indefinitely, including between rooms, unless Hornet takes damage or is otherwise interrupted, like by entering a body of water. 
Releasing Needle Strike in the air suspends Hornet at the same height until the animation ends. This attack can only be aimed left or right. Needle Strike generates 1 strand of [[Silk]] when most enemies are struck. For the Hunter Crest specifically, 2 strands of Silk are generated if both hits connect with an enemy.

Needle Strike changes depending on the equipped [[Crest]]:
* [[Hunter Crest]]: Hornet attacks with 2 consecutive strikes forward. Deals 1.4x [[Needle]] damage per swing, for 2.8x damage in total, granting 1 [[Silk]] each.
* [[Reaper Crest]]: Hornet jumps up slightly and attacks above herself in a wide arc. Deals 2.5x Needle damage.
* [[Wanderer Crest]]: Hornet dashes forward and makes 5 quick jabs forward. Deals 0.6x Needle damage per hit, for 3x Needle damage in total.
* [[Beast Crest]]: Hornet leaps forward, and attacks above and in front of herself. Deals 2.5x Needle damage, or 3x Needle damage in fury state.
* [[Witch Crest]]: Hornet spins and attacks all around herself, similar to [[Cyclone Slash]] in [[Hollow Knight]]. Starting at 2 hits, it can be extended to 6 hits by tapping the ATTACK button. Deals roughly 0.8x Needle damage per hit, up to 4.8x Needle damage in total if all hits of the extended attack land.
* [[Architect Crest]]: Hornet moves forward, then attacks with a large drill-like strike that hits 5 times. Deals 0.6x Needle damage per hit, for 3x Needle damage in total.
* [[Shaman Crest]]: Hornet fires a large wave that travels a moderate distance forward. Deals 2.3x Needle damage.

The damage of Needle Strikes multiplies with other Needle damage increases, such as the Evolved Hunter Crest's Focus, Beast Crest's Fury, and [[Flintslate]].

Needle Strike can instantly destroy [[Gurr the Outcast]]'s traps, and most breakable walls.

[[Pin Badge]] lowers the charge time of Needle Strikes by 40%, from 1.35 seconds to 0.8 seconds.{{MissingRef}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Needle Strike can be acquired after speaking with [[Pinstress]] in [[Blasted Steps]]. When Hornet first meets the Pinstress, she asks Hornet to train with her, after which Hornet gains the ability.

==Trivia==
*The 1.0.27535 and 1.0.27776 versions of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch respectively, which are older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), have the Needle Strike be named Focus Strike.<ref>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GaNLkTTszFKFv55DZj3Iw1hTUi6gbstSR56WXizrMAI Silksong Switch full text] on Google Docs</ref>
*Despite not initially being done, Needle Strikes gave Silk in the <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i> Xbox trailer.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JSfuFlhsxZY Hollow Knight: Silksong - Xbox Game Pass Reveal Trailer - Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase 2022]</ref>
